blocks.translation: Completion Date
Around 1998

blocks.source: ＦＦ４と言えばＳＦＣ初期の発売で『当時の衝撃』が強調されることが多い作品。
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy IV is often remembered for the “shock it caused at the time,” having been released early in the Super Famicom’s lifespan.

blocks.source: 残念ながら、僕の場合はＦＦ５～６よりもかなり後になってプレイしたため、発売当時の衝撃というものを知らない。思い出補正的なものはなく、ＦＦ５～６よりも幾分評価が低いというのは先に断っておきます。
blocks.translation: Unfortunately, I played Final Fantasy IV considerably later than Final Fantasy V and VI, so I never experienced the shock it caused upon release. I have no nostalgia influencing my judgment, and I should make it clear from the outset that I rate it somewhat lower than Final Fantasy V and VI.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Content Volume / Story

blocks.source: 前作のＦＦ３と比べてもダンジョン数がかなり少ない。（ＦＦ３の２５に対して、ＦＦ４は１８）
blocks.translation: Even compared with its predecessor, Final Fantasy III, it has considerably fewer dungeons. (Final Fantasy III has 25, compared with 18 in Final Fantasy IV.)

blocks.source: そして、テンポはそこそこ良い部類なので、意外とあっさり終わる。クリアまで１５～２０時間という所だが、その内３～５時間程度がラストダンジョン。この極端な配分はクロノトリガーにも類似している。
blocks.translation: The pacing is fairly good, so it ends surprisingly quickly. It takes around 15–20 hours to complete, with about 3–5 of those hours spent in the final dungeon. This extreme distribution is similar to Chrono Trigger.

blocks.source: 敵味方共に、多数のキャラクターが登場する。後のドラマ性重視のＲＰＧの先駆け的存在。当時のＲＰＧとしては演出・シナリオ等の面で圧倒的なものがあった。ただし「死んだ」「生きてた」「裏切った」の繰り返しなので、安易に感じる部分も。
blocks.translation: A large number of characters appear on both the enemy and allied sides. It was a pioneering work for later RPGs that emphasized drama. For an RPG of its time, its presentation and scenario were overwhelmingly impressive. However, the repeated cycle of “they died,” “they’re alive,” and “they betrayed us” can also feel simplistic.

blocks.source: とはいえ、王道漫画的な演出で盛り上げるラストバトルは熱い。ＳＦＣ作品のラストバトルではこれとマザー2が良く語り草になっているように思う。
blocks.translation: Even so, the final battle, which builds excitement with classic manga-style presentation, is thrilling. Among Super Famicom final battles, this one and EarthBound 2 seem to be particularly well remembered.

blocks.source: システム
blocks.translation: Systems

blocks.source: この作品で、おなじみＡＴＢ（アクティブタイムバトル）が採用された。コマンドを入力するスピードが重要となる。ただし、この頃はタイムゲージが表示されていないので、順番が分かり辛いのが難点。
blocks.translation: This game introduced the familiar ATB (Active Time Battle) system. The speed at which commands are entered is important. However, the time gauge was not displayed at this point, making it difficult to tell whose turn was next.

blocks.source: ストーリー進行に応じて、キャラクターがころころ入れ替わるので、自由なパーティー編成はできない。また、これといった強化システムがないので、ＦＦ５以降のようなカスタマイズ性はない。というか、ジョブシステムのあったＦＦ３と比較してもシンプルな作り。
blocks.translation: Characters constantly switch in and out as the story progresses, so you cannot freely form your party. Also, since there is no notable enhancement system, it lacks the customization found in Final Fantasy V and later. In fact, it is a simple design even compared with Final Fantasy III, which had the job system.

blocks.source: バランス
blocks.translation: Balance

blocks.source: ＦＦシリーズの中でも、ザコ敵がかなり強く設定されているのが特徴。ラストダンジョンのザコ敵なんて、油断するとすぐに全滅を喰らう。その割に、ボスは弱点さえ付けば拍子抜けするほどあっさり勝てることも。
blocks.translation: One distinctive feature is that the regular enemies are set at a considerably high level of strength, even by Final Fantasy standards. The regular enemies in the final dungeon can wipe out your entire party in no time if you let your guard down. By contrast, some bosses become laughably easy to defeat once you exploit their weaknesses.

blocks.source: ただし、ラスボスを始め、強くて手応えあるボスもいる。
blocks.translation: That said, there are also powerful, challenging bosses, including the final boss.

blocks.source: アサルトドアー等、ボス敵がこちらをほぼ確実に一撃死させるような技を使うことがある。蘇生に使うフェニックスの尾がたったの１００ギルで買えるので対処は簡単。
blocks.translation: Boss enemies such as Assault Door sometimes use techniques that almost certainly kill one of your characters in a single hit. Dealing with this is easy because Phoenix Downs, used for revival, cost only 100 gil.

blocks.source: とはいえ「戦闘不能→蘇生」の多用を想定したゲームバランス自体がちょっと大味な感も。
blocks.translation: Even so, the game balance itself feels somewhat crude in that it seems designed around frequent use of “incapacitated → revival.”

blocks.source: この作品で僕が最も気になったのはエンカウント率の高さ。ザコの強さと相まって辛い。
blocks.translation: What bothered me most about this game was its high encounter rate. Combined with the strength of the regular enemies, it becomes exhausting.

blocks.source: それでいて異様に逃げやすく、戦闘開始と同時にＬＲボタンを同時に押せば瞬時に離脱できてしまう。
blocks.translation: Yet it is extraordinarily easy to flee: if you press the L and R buttons simultaneously as soon as the battle starts, you can escape instantly.

blocks.source: 結果として、エンカウントする度に『逃げる』を多用するというプレイスタイルになった。
blocks.translation: As a result, my play style became one of frequently selecting “Run” whenever I encountered an enemy.

blocks.source: ただし、逃げるとお金を落とすのが嫌らしい。
blocks.translation: However, it is annoying that fleeing causes you to drop some money.

blocks.source: 簡単に逃げられるのは良いのだが、それならそもそものエンカウント率を下げて欲しい――と僕なんかは思った次第。
blocks.translation: Being able to escape easily is nice, but in that case, I found myself thinking that they should have lowered the encounter rate in the first place.

blocks.source: ＦＦ５以降のシリーズ作品では、ジョブやアビリティといった要素が重要で、レベル上げによる強化は軽視されることが多かった。
blocks.translation: In the series from Final Fantasy V onward, elements such as jobs and abilities were important, while strengthening characters by leveling up was often given less emphasis.

blocks.source: それと同じ感覚でＦＦ４をプレイすると難しく感じるのだが、基本的にこのゲームはレベルをしっかり上げることが重要となる。それさえ意識していれば、難しくてクリアできないということにはならないはず。
blocks.translation: Playing Final Fantasy IV with that same mindset makes it seem difficult, but fundamentally, it is important to level up properly in this game. As long as you keep that in mind, it should not become so difficult that you cannot complete it.

blocks.source: 他に困ったところでは、回復魔法を全体化すると効果が人数で等分されてしまうことが挙げられる。ザコ敵は強めだし、ＭＰの消費量も大きいのですぐにＭＰが切れてしまう。ＦＦ５以降のバランスに慣れていると、ここは結構厳しく感じる。
blocks.translation: Another troublesome aspect is that casting a healing spell on the entire party divides its effect evenly among the party members. The regular enemies are fairly strong, and MP consumption is also high, so you quickly run out of MP. If you are accustomed to the balance of Final Fantasy V and later, this can feel quite harsh.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ初期の作品には良くあることだが、移動速度はＦＣのＲＰｇ並に遅いし、文章はひらがなで読みにくい。
blocks.translation: This was common in early Super Famicom games, but movement speed is as slow as in an NES RPG, and the text is difficult to read because it is written in hiragana.

blocks.source: メニュー画面の操作はＦＦ５以降と比べると明らかににぶい。アイテムに持ち数制限があったりするのも微妙に面倒。もっとも、この当時は全種類のアイテムを制限なく持てるようにするという発想自体、珍しかったのだと思われる。
blocks.translation: Menu controls are noticeably sluggish compared with Final Fantasy V and later. It is also mildly inconvenient that items have carrying limits. That said, at the time, the idea of being able to carry unlimited quantities of every type of item was probably unusual in itself.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: 当時は他の追随を許さない圧倒的な演出力があった。いきなり飛空艇の上から始まるオープニングなんて、いかにもこの作品らしい。他にも、イベント戦闘を有効に使った演出が特徴。テラＶＳゴルベーザの戦いや、ラストバトルなどがその例になる。
blocks.translation: At the time, it had an overwhelming level of presentation that no other game could match. An opening that suddenly begins atop an airship is quintessentially this game. It is also notable for its effective use of event battles in its presentation. The battle between Tellah and Golbez and the final battle are examples.

blocks.source: ＳＦＣでも初期の作品なので、さすがにＦＦ５や６と比較すると見劣りは隠せない。特にモンスターグラフィックには大きな差。それでもボス敵のデザインはさすがといったところ。
blocks.translation: Since it is an early Super Famicom game, its shortcomings are unavoidable when compared with Final Fantasy V and VI. The difference is especially large in the monster graphics. Even so, the boss designs are impressive, as expected.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: オープニングで流れるプロローグが印象的。これ以降、ＦＦ１２までプロローグを聴く機会がグッと下がるのは残念。
blocks.translation: The prologue played during the opening is memorable. It is a shame that after this, opportunities to hear a prologue dropped sharply until Final Fantasy XII.

blocks.source: スピード感のある通常＆ボス戦闘曲に圧巻のラスボス曲。当時としては質量共にかなり水準。
blocks.translation: It has fast-paced regular and boss battle themes, along with an astonishing final boss theme. For its time, it was of a notably high standard in both quality and quantity.

blocks.source: 全体的には１ループが短めの曲が多く、ストリングスと管楽器に偏った楽器構成。ＦＦ５～６のようなスルメ感はちょっと足りないかも。
blocks.translation: Overall, many of the tracks have relatively short loops, and the instrumentation is biased toward strings and wind instruments. It may lack some of the lasting appeal of Final Fantasy V and VI.

blocks.source: その他
blocks.translation: Other

blocks.source: ３Ｄ＆ボイス付きのＤＳ版リメイクや、１７年振りの続編『THE AFTER 月の帰還』（携帯＆ＰＳＰ）が存在する。
blocks.translation: There is a 3D, voice-acted DS remake, as well as a sequel released 17 years later, “THE AFTER: Return of the Moon” (mobile and PSP).

blocks.source: 僕はどちらもプレイしていないので、何とも言えないが、聞く所によるとＤＳリメイクはなんと難易度が上昇しているらしい。元々、難しかったのに携帯機リメイク＝低難度というイメージでプレイするとエラいことになりそう。
blocks.translation: I have played neither, so I cannot really say, but from what I hear, the DS remake is surprisingly more difficult. It was already difficult to begin with, so playing a handheld remake with the assumption that handheld remake means low difficulty could lead to serious trouble.
